items.title: FDA calls for stronger potency upkeep in CGT manufacturing
items.summary: The FDA’s CBER director said patients should have assurance that administered products will work as intended.

items.title: AbbVie inks $757m migraine-focused deal with Brise Pharmaceuticals
items.summary: AbbVie and Brise have shared details on this migraine deal two years after the pair originally forged it.

items.title: Lonza to acquire five US manufacturing sites from Merck KGaA
items.summary: Lonza has entered an agreement for the acquisition of five US CDMO sites from Merck KGaA, bringing 1,100 employees into Lonza's workforce.

items.title: Bavarian Nordic secures four-year UK vaccine supply deal
items.summary: Bavarian Nordic has secured a four-year contract from the UK Government to supply its MVA-BN vaccine, used for the prevention of mpox and smallpox.

items.title: Fresenius and WuXi team up in 37-strong biosimilar development deal
items.summary: The deal covers assets that target more than €370bn in originator sales.
